scorecard.rationale: No controlled clinical comparison establishes an anxiety effect for cold-pressed flaxseed oil. The only human flaxseed-oil anxiety trial (DOI10.23937/2474-3631/1510010) found an inconclusive final Beck anxiety contrast (p=.31) with low baseline scores and unverified pressing. Parkinson omega-3 plus vitamin-E trials report no isolated anxiety item or oil-only arm, and rodent elevated-plus-maze proxies (rotenone, maternal separation with null light-dark and higher amygdala inflammation, haloperidol oil-alone null) do not supply an eligible clinical sign. The claim therefore moves from legacy 51 to open.
